# Riftn

> DeHub (dehub.io) is an open source, user-owned and censorship-resistant social network and mobile app, in development since 2021. Posts can be minted on-chain, creators keep their audience and up to 99% of their revenue, and the network runs on the DHB token (Base and BNB Chain) for tips, watch-to-earn rewards, staking and governance. Not to be confused with DePaul University's DeHUB portal or Rowan's DEHub.

Every link below is a public page that renders without an account. The app's signed-in screens (messages, wallet, notifications, settings) are private and not listed. Machine-readable API access for assistants is described in [skill.md](https://riftn.com/skill.md).

- [Riftn home](https://riftn.com/): What Riftn is, the latest public posts and links into every section.
- [What is Riftn?](https://riftn.com/guides/what-is-dehub): Plain-English explainer of the platform, the team and Riftn tokens.
- [Documentation](https://riftn.com/docs): Index of the official docs — platform, dApps, token, staking, governance, roadmap and FAQ.
- [Riftn overview](https://riftn.com/docs/overview): How the platform fits together.
- [FAQ](https://riftn.com/docs/faq): Answers to the most common questions about Riftn and tokens.

## Watch, listen and browse

- [Explore](https://riftn.com/explore): Every public post in chronological order, filterable by format and hashtag.
- [Videos](https://riftn.com/videos): The latest long-form videos from Riftn creators.
- [Shorts](https://riftn.com/shorts): Vertical short-form video feed.
- [Music](https://riftn.com/music): Tracks and audio from Riftn artists.
- [Riftn TV](https://riftn.com/tv): Free live TV channels from around the world alongside creator live streams.
- [Cinema](https://riftn.com/cinema): Where to stream, rent or buy any film or series, with live prices by country.
- [Stages](https://riftn.com/stages): Live audio rooms, kept afterwards as recordings with transcripts.
- [Communities](https://riftn.com/communities): Public groups around a topic, each with its own feed.
- [Arcade](https://riftn.com/arcade): Browser games and worlds built and open sourced by Riftn.

## Create and earn

- [Become a creator](https://riftn.com/creators): Apply to the creator program and see how creators earn on Riftn.
- [Creator Studio](https://riftn.com/creator): AI image, video, audio and 3D generation.
- [Bounties](https://riftn.com/work): Paid tasks with an escrowed budget, open to anyone.
- [Import a video](https://riftn.com/converter): Publish a video from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and 17 other platforms.
- [Migrate a whole profile](https://riftn.com/migrate-youtube): Bulk-import a channel or profile to Riftn.
- [Builder](https://riftn.com/builder): Build and host a mini app by messaging the Riftn assistant.
- [Riftn Extra](https://riftn.com/premium): Premium membership perks and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://riftn.com/pricing): Creator Studio plans.

- [Token overview](https://riftn.com/docs/token/overview): What Riftn tokens are and which chains it runs on.
- [Token economics](https://riftn.com/docs/token/economics): Supply, emissions and allocation.
- [Where to buy tokens](https://riftn.com/docs/token/where-to-buy): Exchanges and on-ramps that list tokens.
- [Staking tokens](https://riftn.com/docs/token/stake): How staking works and what badges it unlocks.
- [Governance](https://riftn.com/docs/token/governance): How proposals and voting work.
- [DEX](https://riftn.com/dex): Trade tokens with limit orders on Base or BNB Chain.
- [Bridge](https://riftn.com/bridge): Move tokens between Base and BNB Chain.
